summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund S filed an 8-K reporting (i) an unregistered sale of 11,570 common shares at $24.17 NAV/share for aggregate proceeds of $279,650 under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S on May 1, 2026 with no underwriting discounts; (ii) a May 2026 distribution of $0.1493 net per share payable June 29, 2026; and (iii) portfolio commentary as of April 30, 2026. This is a routine periodic disclosure containing no acquisition, divestiture, reorganization, or strategic event. No special-situation action is underway, so this filing is classified as 'None'.
